name: Neogen Chemicals Ltd
title: Neogen Chemicals Ltd - 542665 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 22% to INR 247 crore with 17.8% EBITDA margin, but growth is volume-led while battery capex rose and the Pakhajan and Dahej start dates have slipped into FY27.

utilisation.quote: sustained high plant utilization across our core businesses despite ongoing supply chain disruptions

capex.peers_comment: Management said Korean and Chinese electrolyte salt players are announcing capacity, but described only one Korean company as actively pursued.
capex.quote: the revised cost for Pakhajan Phase 2 stands at INR 1,367 crore and expected completion is by March 2027

triggers.label: Pakhajan Phase 2 cost revised to INR 1,367 cr
triggers.quote: the revised cost for Pakhajan Phase 2 stands at INR 1,367 crore and expected completion is by March 2027

triggers.label: Dahej SCOD slips to early Q3
triggers.quote: we will be again on an extension for one sub-section of 1,000 tons capacity, which got delayed and instead of Q1, we are expecting it to start in early Q3

triggers.label: Supplier credit stretched to ~365 days
triggers.quote: we were able to negotiate longer credit terms with them and some of them were also able to get factoring against Neogen's payment lines

triggers.label: Electrolyte salt still 20-25% below formula price
triggers.quote: Now the differential would be, if we look at our formula long-term price, so it would be around 20% to 25%.

triggers.label: Organolithium at 80-90% of expanded capacity
triggers.quote: we are seeing a very strong response to our organolithium business

guidance.quote: We remain confident of achieving revenues in the range of INR 875 to INR 950 crore in FY27 on a standalone basis
We expect to have a INR 300 crore plus kind of revenue from our NIL business.
Commercial manufacturing for electrolyte remains targeted for H1 FY27, while electrolyte salts are expected in H2 FY27.
our FY28 tentative target is around INR 1,100 odd crore
on the battery side, we have already guided to INR 2,500 to INR 2,900 crore
effectively we should be targeting 18% to 20% ROCE, even after the revised capex

guidance.value: unchanged vs earlier INR 1,700 crore peak
guidance.quote: the peak debt will not change. Will remain the same as earlier.
